title: Why Offering a Reward for Fun Can Ruin Your Motivation
hook: Giving a reward for something you enjoy, can destroy that enjoyment.

narration.text: Giving a reward for something you enjoy, can destroy that enjoyment.
This is called the overjustification effect.
Our brains naturally seek reasons for our actions.
When we enjoy an activity, the joy itself is our internal motivation.
Introduce an external reward, and our brains re-evaluate why we do it.
The external reward replaces the internal joy, diminishing our original interest.
This means your hobbies could suffer if they become part of a side hustle.
Have you ever lost interest in something after getting paid for it?

description: Discover the overjustification effect, a fascinating psychological phenomenon. Learn why external rewards can surprisingly reduce your internal motivation for activities you once loved. Understand how this impacts your hobbies and daily life.
topic: Why offering a reward for an activity you enjoy can reduce your motivation for it, explaining the overjustification effect.
